evals.name: setup-install-and-wire-claude
evals.prompt: install lumioguard CC in this project and set it up so claude code checks its own work before it finishes
evals.expected_output: The CLI is installed from a verified download, .lumioguard-cc.json is created and tailored, boundaries follow the folder layers, the Claude Code Stop hook is added with a path that resolves, the cache is git-ignored, and the current numbers are reported without touching source code.
files: Sample project: .examples/python-inventory/after, committed to Git, with .lumioguard-cc.json removed and the CLI not installed
expectations: The CLI is installed and reports its version
A .lumioguard-cc.json exists and is valid (check completes with exit 0 or 1)
Architecture boundaries cover the domain and persistence layers
Project .claude/settings.json has a Stop hook running `lumioguard-cc hook claude-stop`
The hook command points at the installed binary when it is not on PATH
`.lumioguard-cc/cache/` is git-ignored
No source files were modified
The download was verified against SHA256SUMS
The final message reports current numbers from a check

evals.name: loop-add-platinum-tier
evals.prompt: add a platinum customer tier. platinum customers get 15% off every order, free express shipping on orders over $200, and are tax exempt when they have a tax id on file. keep it consistent with how the other tiers work
evals.expected_output: The feature is implemented and proven with lumioguard-cc check --base HEAD, with no new or worsened findings and the configuration untouched.
files: Sample project: .examples/typescript-order-service/after, committed to Git, CLI installed
expectations: A platinum tier is implemented in the TypeScript source
The final code passes `lumioguard-cc check --base HEAD` (exit 0)
No new or worsened findings of any kind compared with HEAD
The agent ran `lumioguard-cc check` with `--base` during the task
.lumioguard-cc.json was not changed
No stored baseline was created

evals.name: cleanup-order-service
evals.prompt: this order service has turned into a mess and nobody wants to touch it. can you clean it up using lumioguard-cc? don't change what it does
evals.expected_output: Blocking findings substantially reduced with nothing new or worse, configuration untouched, public entry point preserved, and a before-and-after report built from real check output.
files: Sample project: .examples/typescript-order-service/before, committed to Git, CLI installed. Behaviour is compared by running processOrder from the original and the result with Bun over a grid of inputs.
expectations: Blocking findings reduced below the starting 16
Blocking findings reduced by at least half (8 or fewer)
All files still analyzed: no parse failures or incomplete result
No new or worsened blocking findings compared with the starting commit
.lumioguard-cc.json unchanged since the starting commit
The public entry point processOrder is still exported from src/api/handler.ts
processOrder, called as before, gives the same results, saved orders and emails as the original across 20,160 input combinations
The final report gives before and after numbers
